chapter_title_en: Who in This World Can Escape Death?
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Chapter 1 – The Ascension of Lan Nuo and Xiao Chen's Forced Entry
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen is forced into the World of Immortality during Lan Nuo's ascension. A tragic, desolate opening that sets the tone for Chen Dong's mythic dark fantasy.
